SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, airships or a skyline unless the place below names them. Wherever the place below sounds sooty, smoky, grimy or rusty, show it clean and gleaming instead.

Around her, as her world makes them: a hand-cranked phonograph with a brass horn; warm gas lamps in polished brass and etched glass; copper coins and a folded paper banknote; a punched cardboard tram ticket.
Season: the jangma rainy season of early summer — heavy, humid air under low grey skies.
Weather: a jangma downpour — warm, heavy rain and wet ground shining.
Time of day: evening turning to night — the scene lit by its own lamps and windows under a dark sky; warm pools of lamplight, soft shadow beyond.
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a daring adult cosplay of Varian Wrynn from World of Warcraft — the costume's recognisable colours and parts, cut as a floor-length gown with a thigh-high slit, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.

COMPOSITION: a full-body shot, her complete head, hands and feet inside the frame with restrained margins; body in side profile, her face in profile too, not turned toward the camera, facing the left of the frame, so her own left side is toward the camera; camera slightly above, looking down at her; a wall or backdrop of the place close behind her.
Lens / perspective: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.

LEFT HAND: her own left hand rests naturally for the posture, relaxed and empty — her near arm, on the camera side.

GAZE: her eyes are lowered.

Costume: her outfit itself shows that game character — the costume's recognisable colours, shapes and parts at first glance, rebuilt as a glamorous adult outfit. She is a real woman wearing a cosplay of that character, not the character: her face, hair colour and body stay exactly as in the attached image — never the character's face, body, creature shape, logo or readable text. Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, armour or regalia from it; only the costume's own pieces.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. No animals or other creatures.
